# Salmon Software

> Salmon Software is a small software engineering practice based in Tauranga, New Zealand, building thoughtful web systems and quiet automation.

Salmon Software values slow thought, clean architecture, deterministic tools, care, and accountability. It builds software that respects the people and businesses relying on it.

- Website: https://salmonsoftware.nz
- Email: ben@salmonsoftware.nz
- Location: Tauranga, Bay of Plenty, New Zealand

## The Craft

- Web Systems: Fast, honest software that respects the person on the other side of the screen.
- Quiet Automation: Taking the repetitive weight off human shoulders so teams can return to real work.
- Human Judgment: Listening closely to how a business breathes before a single line of code is written.
